prompt: The request describes the future process to generate after this initial image. Give only the physical dependencies needed to realize that process. Return one to four numbered sentences, each at most 24 words. Each should connect a relevant cause, contact, or material condition to an observable response and any essential property that must persist. Prioritize the requested transition over incidental details of the scene. An event absent in the initial frame may occur later; do not replace the requested process with no change. Treat requested future actions as conditional, without claiming they are already observed. Do not invent causes, measurements, timing, or unseen initial facts. Omit sweat, lighting, generic air resistance and other incidental effects unless essential to the request. Use fewer sentences when fewer dependencies are relevant; do not pad the list. No introduction or law names.
